subject: Pilot validation: 3-week sprint — owners, gates & weekly rally
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Anna Liu <anna.liu@novushealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Quick recap + proposed 3-week pilot runbook (next steps)

Hi Anna — thanks again for the call earlier. Short recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth.

Recap (what we heard):
- Goal: validate Redwood inference for a customer-facing triage assistant (60-80% intent coverage, <150ms p95 on typical queries).
- Key success criteria: accuracy on the three priority intents, latency target, and integration with Novus SSO and audit logs.
- Constraints: sample data is redacted, infra team will provide a staging VM with access rules.

Proposed Pilot (3 weeks):
1) Week 0 (this week) — environment setup, access + baseline perf run
2) Week 1 — model/probe validation against sample prompts, iterate prompt templates
3) Week 2 — end-to-end integration test + acceptance run vs. success criteria

Owners (proposed):
- Redwood technical lead: Jordan Blake (me) — main contact, model/config changes
- Redwood CS / onboarding: Monica Patel — test orchestration, acceptance checklist
- Novus infra: Rajiv Sen — staging access and log exports

Immediate asks from us:
- Can Rajiv share a staging VM hostname and an SSH user for the test harness by Friday?
- Anna — confirm the three priority intents in the attached sheet and any additional acceptance KPIs.

I attached a draft runbook (redwood-pilot-runbook-v1.pdf) and a success-criteria spreadsheet. If that looks good I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff for Thursday.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake

Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:17:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed 3-week pilot runbook (next steps)

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Success criteria edits (we updated the sheet):
- Intent coverage: target 75%+ on the three intents (triage, scheduling, lab-info) on the redacted test set.
- Latency: p95 < 180ms on our staging VM (we're OK if you hit 150ms on better hardware).
- Auditability: request/response logs must include a request_id and be retained for 30 days for now.

2) Timing: Rajiv can provision staging and provide credentials by Friday EOD if all good.
3) Can you include a short checklist for what log fields you need? Rajiv will prioritize that.

I approve the proposed owners. Please proceed and set up the kickoff for Thursday.

— Anna
Anna Liu

Novus Health

Weekly status template (Week 0/1):
- High level status: green/yellow/red + 1-line summary
- Blockers (owner, impact, ETA)
- Completed this week (bullets)
- Next week (owner, expected deliverable)
- Open decisions (owner + desired resolution date)

First-week asks (this week):
- Rajiv: share SSH creds and the staging VM FQDN + a test S3 bucket by Fri 10/2 (owner: Rajiv)
- Jordan: run baseline perf probe against the staging VM and post results to the shared drive by Mon 10/5
- Anna: final sign-off on the three intent definitions in the spreadsheet by Mon 10/5

I’ll post the first status update on Monday 10/5 with a short action table. If anything changes, reply here so the log is up to date.
